releases.name: SampQOL OS 0.4.0 (beta)
releases.body:
SampQOL OS is a free mod for the MPC Sample firmware 1.3.0 (1.3.0.12). It starts from the SD card and does not change the stock firmware. With the SD card in, it starts by itself. Without the SD card, the MPC starts as stock 1.3.0.

Tested only with MPC Sample 1.3.0. MPC One, Live and X are not tested yet. This is beta software: back up your projects first. A failed project load can delete samples (see the manual, "Project safety net").

## New in 0.4.0

- USB Click Repair (Beta): in Settings. It repairs the short clicks in the USB audio input that some phones send (reported: Google Pixel 8a). Default Off. Idea from USB DeClick by odeo0.
- Pad FX on the input: put the stock Pad FX (for example Beat Repeat) on the Input FX page. The Pad FX pads then work on the input and the main mix at the same time.
- The FADER can send a MIDI CC: select MIDI CC in the FADER menu. Set the CC number and the channel on the Overrides page (B2) of the FADER menu.
- Time signature per sequence: in Settings, set Time Sig to Per Seq. Each sequence keeps its own time signature (for example A01 in 4/4, A02 in 3/4). SHIFT + K2 on the SEQ screen changes only the current sequence.
- Screen text for blind users: over the USB cable, the screen reader of your computer reads the MPC screen aloud. Open http://mpc-sample.local:7410/speak in a browser. It reads the screen name, the selected item, the knob values, the file names in the browsers, each character that you type, the Step Edit cell under the cursor and what is muted. Other tools can read the text at /a11y.txt.
- Load Kit from Sample Select: the list also shows kits (.xpm, .xtd and .mpcsample). B3 or the ENCODER loads the kit. When the track has samples, the MPC asks: Replace, or New Track (one UNDO removes the new track and the kit). A kit with a preview file in [Previews] plays it. SHIFT + K1 shows All, Audio (samples only) or Kits; the MPC keeps your last choice.
- Load Kit also loads a .xtd drum track (MPC 3 expansions, for example from an MPC Live 3): it loads the samples of the first layer of each pad.
- Stems Separation: separate a sample into stems (Drums, Bass, Vocals, Other), on the MPC itself. Push SAMPLE, select the pad, then SHIFT + B3. Each stem goes to its own pad, or Merge puts the stems that you keep on one pad (for example an instrumental without the vocals). Fast or High quality. The chops of the sample stay on each stem. One UNDO removes the stems. You can also put Stems Separation on a SHIFT + pad (Settings > Shortcuts).
- ERASE + pad can also erase the notes and automation of the pad in all sequences: set Events on (B2) in the ERASE PAD window. The window shows the sequences that have notes of the pad. The MPC keeps your last choice. It also works on the SAMPLE RECORD screen, so you can remove a To Seq take in one step.
- ERASE PAD for several pads at once: in the ERASE PAD window, push more pads to add them (also from other pad banks). Do It! erases all of them, and one UNDO brings all of them back. The chosen pads light red.
- Mute notes in Step Edit: select notes in the Pad View or Track View and push MUTE. The notes stay but do not play, and they show grey. MUTE again on the same notes plays them again. With Mute Type Audio, the pad stops at a muted note. Notes of a pad or track that a mute or a Solo silences also show grey.
- Humanize in the Pad View (SHIFT + B3): small random changes to the timing, velocity and length of the notes, so a programmed beat sounds played. Feel keeps the strong beats steady and adds a slow drift; Eagerness puts all notes ahead of or behind the beat. Shuffle until you like it, then Done; Cancel puts the notes back. Idea by planjm.
- Multi Select: change several pads at once. On the SAMPLE screen, hold SAMPLE and hold a pad for 1 second, then add pads with SAMPLE + pad. A knob turn, the Key and the KEYS root note then set the same value on all selected pads. One UNDO puts all of them back. Settings can turn it off.
- Multi Select in the Mixer: on the Pad, Track and Submix pages, hold PAD FX and hold a pad for 1 second, then add pads, tracks or submixes with PAD FX + pad. K1 then moves the volume of all of them by the same dB, K2 sets the same mute group and K3 the same Out. One UNDO per turn.

## Changed in 0.4.0

- SEQ mode, SEQ + pad and COPY of a sequence: the current sequence is magenta, a sequence with events is dim magenta. Before, they were green and yellow, the same green as the tracks in Track Mute.
- Submixes 2-8 that no pad or track goes to use less CPU.
- When a file in the autorun folder is not the file of the release zip, SampQOL OS does not start (as before). The file autorun/logs/events.log then shows "pin check failed".
- Chop Mode Extract: the recorded chop notes go to the new chop pads, in every sequence (K3 Events Yes). Before, they stayed on the chopped pad. With Replace, the MPC removes the old notes of the replaced pads.
- Load Project: the ENCODER push on a .xpm or .xtd file loads the kit, as B3 Load Kit.
- Rec Quantize popup (SHIFT + PAD 10): K1 (Swing) shows and sets the swing of the recorded notes (50 to 75 %). It is the Time Correct Swing, which Note Repeat also uses. Stock shows it only as a bar on the Time Correct screen (SHIFT + PAD 14).
- More Undo steps: the KEYS root note (SAMPLE, Tune page, SHIFT + K1), the Tuner Apply, a pad mute or unmute in Mute mode (as on the Pad Mixer), and in the Mixer a turn of K3 (Out) or of the track or submix mute group (K2). Auto Key is no Undo step of its own: the first Undo after a recording or a load removes the new sample, and its key goes with it.
- Pad View and Track View: with the FADER on Zoom, SHIFT + FADER zooms the bars (as SHIFT + K3) and the FADER the rows. Settings > Fader Overrides > Fader Zoom swaps them.
- Pad View and Track View: Bars zooms from 1/4 bar (a column = 1/64) to 32 bars (a column = 2 bars). Was 1 to 8 bars.
- SHIFT + PLAY loops exactly the selection, also a part of a bar (for example 2 beats or one step), in all time signatures. Before, it looped whole bars of 4/4: in 5/4 it also played the next bar, in 3/4 the bar before.
- Settings: the groups open and close, so the list is short. The MPC keeps the groups that you opened. On a new install, all groups are closed.
- CPU/RAM Monitor: a new install uses Warn Only. The bar then shows only when the audio processing is near its limit for 3 seconds, when the RAM is almost full, or after an audio dropout. Your saved setting stays.
- To Seq and Looper: with the metronome set to Record, you hear the click during the whole take, also in each Looper pass. When the loop only plays, the click stops.
- Looper (SAMPLE RECORD): when you set Looper on, K2 (the recording length) goes to Free. When you set K2 to Seq, Looper goes off.
- To Seq: while you record on a pad, you do not hear the old take of that pad. Only a Looper layer plays the old loop, so you can play on top of it. Idea by macdonaldster.
- Export: the file names have the sequence, for example "MyTrack - S02 Verse - Tr01 - Drums.wav", so you can export all sequences of a project. Before, the second sequence asked "File exists" and wrote over or next to the files of the first. The row File Name sets the parts of the name and their order: Project, Sequence, BPM and the date (YYMMDD or YY-MM-DD). It replaces the row BPM in Name. B3 Export first shows the name: you can change it or add text. Settings > Time Zone sets the local date (the MPC clock runs in UTC).
- Name screens (Save Sample, Save Project, Rename): you can type "_".
- Pad mutes per sequence, as track mutes: each sequence keeps its own pad mutes. A pad that you mute is muted only in the current sequence. Before, a pad mute stayed on in all sequences, and a recorded pad mute could stay on in the next sequence.
- Settings > Ask Before Erase Pad has a new value, Pads With Events: ERASE + pad asks only for a pad that has notes or automation in a sequence. It is the default for a new install; your saved setting stays (On is now Always). Off is the stock ERASE + pad: the MPC erases the sample at once, without a question.
- Sample Select: a pad with a sample now plays its own sound (Own Sample). The selected pad or an empty pad plays the file. This is the new setting for all users, also after an update. For the old way, turn SHIFT + K2 to the left (Preview). The MPC keeps that choice.
- Pad View and Track View: a note that you played a little early belongs to the grid line where you see most of it. The cursor and a selection take it there. A short note stays in the cell where you see it.
- Pad View: the small + shows only on notes that you cannot see apart (two notes of a pad at almost the same time). Before, at Bar zoom it showed on almost every note.

## Fixed in 0.4.0

- Screen changes show no other screen in between: PAD FX to the Mixer and back to SEQ or SAMPLE RECORD, Pad View, Track View, Settings, the Export page, the Input FX page, the Mixer pages (B1, B2) and a quick SEQ tap on the SAMPLE screen. Before, another screen, an empty page or the sequence name could show for a moment.
- PAD BANK + ENCODER: the pads without a track stay off while you turn. Before, they could light up for a moment at each step.
- A pad colour that you give with Rename stays after a project load and after a restart. Before, the pads of the current track went back to the default colour.
- Pad View and Track View show the bar lines, bar numbers and position of the time signature of the sequence. Before, they showed bars of 4/4 in all time signatures.
- New track: the pads with a sample are blue, as on the other tracks. Before, they were green on the SAMPLE screen (the colour of the track pick and Track Mute). A project with these green tracks gets blue pads when you load it.
- To Seq with Looper on: you hear the first click of the COUNT-IN. Before, the first click (and all sound for a short moment) was often lost when you tapped the pad.
- To Seq and Looper: a take gets the tempo of the sequence. With Warp on in mode Pitch, it plays at the right pitch and speed. Before, the MPC guessed the tempo of the take, and the take could play out of tune and too fast (for example half a semitone and 4 BPM).
- Rename a track, submix, pad or sequence: an ENCODER push goes to the next character, as in stock. Before, the push did nothing.
- SEQ mode: the pads show which sequences have events at once. Before, the first time after a new or loaded project, all pads lit, and after a recording or an Undo a pad could show the old state until PLAY, STOP or a pad press.
- SAMPLE screen, Pad FX and Flex Beat with the KNOB FX bar open: SEQ + pad changes the sequence and you stay on the screen. Before, SEQ opened the SEQ screen.
- Chop Mode: when you go to SEQ and back to SAMPLE, the SAMPLE screen shows the bank of before Chop Mode. Before, it showed bank A, and you had to find the sample again.
- COPY on the same track, B3 Replace: each destination pad gets its own copy of the sample, as in stock. Before, the pads shared one sample, and a chop change on one pad changed the chops on the other pads too.
- When the internal storage is full, a project save keeps the pad names and track MIDI channels of before. Before, a save on full storage could lose them.
- Looper with a long loop: the MPC uses much less memory when it puts the passes together. Before, a loop of almost 3 minutes used more than 100 MB, and with little free memory the MPC could freeze.
- A home or export folder typed by hand in mpcqol.conf without a "/" opens the normal folder. Before, the MPC could crash when you opened the folder pick in QOL Settings or Export.

## Fixed in 0.4.0 (stock problems)
